OUR SERVICES

Two ways we bring your design to life

Pick the finish that suits your fabric and budget — or combine both on one piece.

Sublimation Printing

Full-color, all-over designs fused directly into the fabric. Best for jerseys, caps and detailed graphics.

  • Unlimited colors, no extra cost
  • Never cracks or peels
  • Great for sportswear & full-front designs

Embroidery Patches

Stitched, textured patches for a premium, durable look. Best for jackets, caps and uniform logos.

  • Raised, textured finish
  • Iron-on or sew-on options
  • Great for varsity jackets & uniform badges

FAQ

Common questions

What sports do you make sportswear for?

Cricket, football, basketball, volleyball, hockey, cycling and tennis, along with school, college and company uniforms.

What is sublimation printing?

A full-color design is fused directly into the fabric using heat, rather than sitting on top like a sticker — so it won't crack or peel.

Can I add custom names and numbers?

Yes. Mention the names and numbers you need in your quote request, and we'll include them in the design.

Can I add my own logo?

Yes — either sublimation-printed into the fabric or as an embroidery patch, depending on where it's going and the look you want.

Do you take bulk or team orders?

Yes, we work with teams, clubs, schools and companies on bulk and institutional orders. Share your quantity and sizes in the quote form.

How do I get a quote?

Fill out the Get a Quote form below or message us on WhatsApp with your requirements — our team will review the details and get back to you.

How long does an order take?

It depends on quantity, design complexity and current order load. Share your required date in the quote form and our team will confirm the timeline.
